notes: v464 — two fixes from real screens. (1) 📉 DIP PRICES YOU CAN ACTUALLY PLACE. The Dip Finder was offering prices like $0.149 and $0.147 on a 15c share — neither exists: between 10c and $2 the ASX only trades in half-cent steps, so a broker would reject them. Every suggestion now snaps to a real tick and tells you the dip that price TRULY is. Where a depth is finer than the share's own step (a 0.5% dip on a 15c share is smaller than one tick) it's dropped with an explanation rather than shown as a price you can't use. (2) 📊 OPEN/HIGH/LOW STOPPED AFTER ~A WEEK in the history window. The repair that refetches full history was only firing when more than half of the last ten days were missing — with 5-7 good recent days it sat just under the trigger forever. It now judges the window you're actually looking at. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5) to update.
